content:
**Might Makes Right** is a quest in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Burning Springs* update.

The Vault Dweller is tasked by The Rust King to travel to Highway Town, and speak with Runt. Inside Highway Town, the Vault Dweller has to find the Last Resort and speak with the bar's owner, Millstone, who will direct the Vault Dweller to a small maintenance closet where Runt can be found inside.

After speaking with Runt, he will task the Vault Dweller with completing three Tests of Might. These tasks can be found under the "Burning Springs" tab in the Challenges menu.

Once completed, the Vault Dweller will then have to complete four Tests of Dominance, which can be found in the same menu mentioned above. But, when the Vault Dweller finishes the tasks and returns to Runt they will find him dead. Eugene will be there waiting for the Vault Dweller instead, who tells them he killed Runt. He will tell the Vault Dweller he is planning an uprising against The Rust King and his kingdom.
